note: Both sets share most claims, including the dubious pairing of keynote code 05 12 23.A7 as a 'specification' of the HSS and the unsupported 'C3X6 quantity 1'. Set A adds two claims with fabricated or misbound quotes: 'W10X12 TYP' (the text has W10X12 and 1/4" TYP as separate annotations) and 'C3X6 length 1'-4"' (1'-4" is a standalone dimension, not a length of the channel). Set B instead correctly captures the HSS member size 4X4X1/4 from HSS4X4X1/4, which A omits, so B is the more faithful set despite its duplicate W8X10 entries and the shared 'TYP C3X6' invented quote.
